source.sqlReaderQuery:
select
max(starttime) as starttime
from Payments2.job j
where j. jobtype = 2
and status in (2,3)
and j.starttime = (select max(starttime) from Payments2.job where jobtype = 2)
and not exists (
select 1
from Payments2.job j2
where j2. jobtype = 6
and j2. starttime > j. starttime
)

source.sqlReaderQuery:
select
    c.AcademicYear as CurrentAcademicYear,
    c.CollectionPeriod as CurrentCollectionPeriod,
    isnull(cast(p.AcademicYear as varchar(10)), '') as PreviousAcademicYear,
    isnull(cast(p.CollectionPeriod as varchar(10)), '') as PreviousCollectionPeriod
from (
    select top 1 j.AcademicYear, j.CollectionPeriod
    from Payments2.Job j
    where JobType = 1
    order by j.AcademicYear desc, j.CollectionPeriod desc
) c
outer apply (
    select top 1 j.AcademicYear, j.CollectionPeriod
    from Payments2.Job j
    where j.JobType = 1
    and j.AcademicYear < c.AcademicYear
    order by j.AcademicYear desc, j.CollectionPeriod desc
) last_year
outer apply (
    select last_year.AcademicYear, last_year.CollectionPeriod
    where last_year.AcademicYear is not null
    and not exists (
        select 1
        from Payments2.Job s
        where s.JobType = 6
        and s.AcademicYear = last_year.AcademicYear
        and s.CollectionPeriod = last_year.CollectionPeriod
    )
) p
